output.headline: Accepts Teach for America's free teacher training and summer school at Roosevelt Middle
output.summary: This no-cost memorandum of understanding (a partnership agreement) lets Teach for America provide five weeks of teacher training, including four weeks of teaching summer school, at Roosevelt Middle School. Subjects include elementary reading, writing and math, and secondary English, math and science. It runs January 1, 2019 through December 31, 2021 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Pays a finance contractor up to $18,000 for year-end audit, payroll and closing support

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $18,000.00

output.summary: The district hires an outside contractor from Danville to help with last year's unaudited financial figures and audit, run payroll, and guide accounting staff through closing the books. The contract runs August 1 through October 31, 2019, and is capped at $18,000.

output.headline: Accepts free gardening classes for Thornhill Elementary students through August 2022
output.summary: This no-cost memorandum of understanding (a partnership agreement) has a local provider teach a series of gardening classes at Thornhill Elementary School. Students learn hands-on biology and ecology and where food comes from. It runs August 12, 2019 through August 12, 2022 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Ratifies a contract up to $66,200 for safety and youth development help for newcomer students

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $66,200.00

output.summary: The Board approves, after the start date, a contract with an Oakland contractor to run a safety intervention and youth development program for newcomer students, through the English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department. It runs August 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and is capped at $66,200.

output.headline: Accepts free music camps from Cazadero Performing Arts Camp for middle school students
output.summary: Cazadero Performing Arts Camp will offer its "Jump Start In Music" and "Summer Music Camp" outdoor music camps to participating middle school music students, with high school student mentors helping. The camps run from September 15, 2019 through September 15, 2022 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $65,000 for Syntex Global translators at special education meetings

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $65,000.00

This includes legally required translation for Individualized Education Program (IEP) meetings. The contract runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, is capped at $65,000, and began before Board approval.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $6,000 for Adkinstrak Timing to time track and cross country meets

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $6,000.00

output.summary: Adkinstrak Timing Associates of Vallejo provides customized timing for track and field and cross country meets through the Oakland Athletic League. The contract runs September 2, 2019 through May 27, 2020 and is capped at $6,000. It began before Board approval.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $30,000 for HERO coaching and mentoring at Horace Mann Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $30,000.00

output.summary: HERO of Oakland provides a coach for organized games and physical activities, the Young Hero Leadership Program for upper grade students, and counseling and mentoring at Horace Mann Elementary School. The contract runs August 12, 2019 through May 28, 2020 and is capped at $30,000. It began before Board approval.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $27,000 for HERO mentoring, leadership and recess support at Garfield Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $27,000.00

output.summary: HERO of Oakland provides mentoring and leadership services at Garfield Elementary School, including a Young HERO leadership program for upper grade students twice a week, plus physical education and recess support for all grades. The contract runs September 3, 2019 through May 28, 2020 and is capped at $27,000. It began before Board approval.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $30,000 for HERO counseling, mentoring and recess programs at Parker Elementary

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $30,000.00

output.summary: HERO of Oakland provides counseling and mentoring for Title I, Latino, African American and second-language students at Parker Elementary School. Services include social skills lessons, a leadership program, mentoring, professional development and organized recess. The contract runs August 12, 2019 through May 28, 2020, is capped at $30,000, and began before Board approval.

output.headline: Awards Shah Kawasaki Architects $3.5M to design the Cole Administration Center project

output.summary: The Board awards the architectural design contract for the Cole Administration Center project to Shah Kawasaki Architects of Oakland, for $3,500,000. Work starts September 12, 2019 and runs until December 31, 2022. It is paid from Measure J bond funds.

output.headline: Adds $7,537.62 for Star Elevator's emergency elevator repairs at McClymonds High

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $7,537.62

output.summary: This amendment adds $7,537.62 to an existing contract with Star Elevator for emergency repairs to the passenger elevator at McClymonds High School. It raises the contract limit from $34,688.90 to $42,226.52. The contract period began March 14, 2019, before this approval, and runs through December 31, 2019.

output.headline: Pays First Alarm Security & Patrol up to $165,000 for alarm response and off-hours site monitoring

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $165,000.00

output.summary: First Alarm Security & Patrol of San Jose responds to alarms and monitors district sites when District Police Services officers are off duty, including holidays and weekends. The contract runs July 22, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and is capped at $165,000.

output.headline: Subcontracts up to $450,000 of child care funding to the Spanish Speaking Unity Council

output.headline: Ratifies up to $45,000 for Board on Track to support charter school board appointments

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $45,000.00

output.summary: Board on Track of Concord, Massachusetts helps the Office of Charter Schools with appointments to charter school boards. It builds video training modules for appointees, advises staff on reporting materials and applicant matching, and gives selected boards a skills appraisal in June 2020. The contract runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and is capped at $45,000. It began before Board approval.

output.headline: Awards R.F. MacDonald $59,433 without bidding to replace Castlemont High's boiler
output.summary: The Board awards R.F. MacDonald Company of Oakland a $59,433 contract for the Castlemont High School boiler replacement. The title says the contract was not competitively bid. Work starts September 12, 2019 and ends December 31, 2019.

output.headline: Awards Alaniz Construction $37,212 without bidding to repair a parking lot at Sankofa kitchen site
output.summary: The Board awards Alaniz Construction, Inc. of Oakland $37,212 for labor and materials to repair existing parking lot pavement as part of the Washington (Sankofa) Finishing Kitchen project. The contract was not competitively bid. The work was scheduled for August 8 through August 10, 2019, before this approval.

output.headline: Pays Rook Electric $20,950 for security equipment work done in May 2019, without bidding
output.summary: The Board approves payment of $20,950 to Rook Electric of Oakland for repairs and installation of security equipment, as listed on attached invoices. The agreement covers payment only for work already performed from May 1 through May 17, 2019. The contract was not competitively bid.

output.headline: Subcontracts up to $250,000 of child care funding to the City of Oakland's child development agency

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $250,000.00

output.summary: The district passes part of its 2019-20 state child development grant to the City of Oakland, through its Child Development Agency, for up to $250,000. output.headline: Accepts free after-school study sessions from Study Buddy at Redwood Heights Elementary
output.summary: This no-cost memorandum of understanding (a partnership agreement) has Study Buddy provide after-school study sessions at Redwood Heights Elementary School. Sessions focus on math, reading and writing, with the provider working with teachers and parents. It runs August 5, 2019 through August 5, 2022 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Ratifies up to $25,000 for a contractor to supervise counseling interns at Oakland International High

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $25,000.00

output.summary: An Oakland contractor supervises counseling interns and attends student support team and partner meetings at Oakland International High School. The contract runs August 12, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and is capped at $25,000. It began before Board approval.

output.headline: Approves a side agreement with the teachers union on release time for a National Education Association grant
output.summary: The district and the Oakland Education Association (OEA), the teachers union, sign a side letter about the National Education Association (NEA) Community Schools Grant. It gives a teacher release time from the classroom to take part in OEA leadership, for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The side letter itself stays in effect through June 30, 2022. The text states no dollar amount.

output.headline: Authorizes up to $22M in 2019-20 contracts with nonpublic schools and agencies for special education

money.evidence: in a cumulative amount not to exceed $22,000,000.00

The total for all of them is capped at $22,000,000 for the 2019-20 fiscal year. The text does not name the individual schools or agencies.

output.headline: Extends SERP's chemistry curriculum work to July 2020 and accepts an $80,000 Koshland grant
output.sourceIssueCandidate: The title calls this an extension of time, but the text also says the district is accepting an $80,000 grant award; it is unclear whether that is new money or the original grant restated.

output.headline: Changes the date for recognizing the district's 2019-2020 Teacher of the Year
output.summary: This resolution sets a new date for the Board to recognize the Oakland Unified School District's 2019-2020 Teacher of the Year. The text does not state the new date or any cost.
